description: Source code for the CoGroupedIterator class in Apache Spark, which iterates over grouped data from two iterators based on a grouping schema, returning combined grouped records.

classes.name: CoGroupedIterator
classes.description: An iterator that performs a co-group operation over two input iterators of grouped data, returning combined records with matching keys.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Checks if there are more elements to iterate over, advancing the internal state if necessary.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next co-grouped record, combining data from both iterators based on the grouping key.

methods.name: leftOnly
methods.description: Returns a record with data only from the left iterator when the right is exhausted or has a different key.

methods.name: rightOnly
methods.description: Returns a record with data only from the right iterator when the left is exhausted or has a different key.
